title: 第962章 主人我们要继续仙人跳吗第961章 需要多感悟几门大成真意
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
孔渔的身躯在密林中飞速的穿行。
她的身形曼妙多姿，作为血孔雀族的女神，被诸多修士所爱慕。
孔渔的姿容绝对是没有问题的，她的绝色，甚至能排的进血孔雀族历代美女的前列。
但是，如今的她，已经沦为了一个人族的阶下囚。
若是可以，那人族可以肆意的凌虐她。
她只能庆幸，那人族并不是一个放肆的人，不会沉浸于对她做不好的事情。
修长无瑕的长腿在密林的树木之上一个点踏，整个人便划过一个优美的弧度，飞速的驰掠而出。
忽而，她挺直了驰掠，落在了地面，黛眉微微蹙起。
她环顾四周，没有看到任何人的影子。
李浪和陈丹求，像是直接从天地之间抹去消失一般，她感知不到。
她知道，这是李浪所掌握的强大的敛息秘术。
不过，此刻，她在意的不是这些。
而是……
“谁？！”
“出来！”
孔渔深吸一口气，美眸之中闪烁过一抹厉色。
“哈哈哈，居然被发现了，不愧是血孔雀一族的天之骄女啊。”
有几分霸道的笑声，忽而响彻而起，继而，一棵大树之上，一道身影逐渐显现出来。
那是一位黄金虎族的修士，虎族的标志很明显。
他双手抱胸，另外双臂狂舞，立足在大树之上，俯瞰着底下的孔渔，眼眸之中闪烁过淫邪之色。

“早先在发现你的时候，我就偷偷跟上来了……”
“嘿嘿……”
黄金虎族的修士，一跃而下，落在地上，强大的气场轰然迸发开来。
地源后期！
这是一位地源后期的黄金虎族修士，气息很强大，至少，比孔渔要强大太多。
孔渔黛眉蹙起，盯着眼前之人，似乎在脑海之中，搜罗着这个人的名字。
忽而，一个名字闪烁而过。
“黄池！”
“黄金虎族的黄池，是你？！”
孔渔厉声喝道。
“哎哟，没有想到孔渔女神还认得在下啊，真是难得……看来在下在孔渔女神心中，还是有一点位置的。”
黄池舒展身躯，黄金虎族就是以肉身强横着称，他们没有修炼武道，可肉身强度，便已然有着寻常武道大宗师的层次。
这便是鬼兽族的天赋，厉害的鬼兽族血肉天生强大，能够承载更多的鬼神之力。
“你偷偷跟踪我？你想要做什么？”
孔渔站在原地，姣好美艳的面庞之上，满是厉色。
“还能做什么……我首先要确定一下，你是否有同行之人，现在看来，你当真是孤身一人，我自然是要当护花使者啊。”
“你这么美丽，一个人在这不安全的密林中前行，多么危险啊，我自然是要来保护你。”
“不过，既然保护你，自然也是要收些利息……”
黄池脸上不由浮现出了淫邪笑意，眸光肆无忌惮的打量着孔渔姣好的身材与面容，喉头吞吐，上下滚动。
好似有燥热之火，瞬间涌上心头，无法遏制。

“你！”
孔渔心中也是有几分惊怒之意，被对方肆意的目光，惹得恼怒非常。
黄池之名，她当然也听说过，乃是黄金虎族之中的一个败类，出了名的淫邪好色，不少与黄金虎族联姻的族女，都被黄池折磨的不成人样！
没有想到，这一次黑魔原之行，黄池此人也来了。
不过想来也是，黄池在黄金虎族之内，天赋极其不寻常，只比第一梯队的黄飞宇，黄飞鲤等人差上些许。
content_en:
Kong Yu's body moved quickly through the dense forest.
She has a graceful and graceful figure. As the goddess of the Blood Peacock Tribe, she is loved by many monks.
There is absolutely no problem with Kong Yu's appearance. Her stunning beauty can even rank at the forefront of the beauties of the Peacock tribe in the past.
However, now she has become a prisoner of the human race.
If possible, then the human race can abuse her arbitrarily.
She could only be glad that the human was not an impudent person and would not indulge in doing bad things to her.
The slender and flawless long legs stepped on the trees in the dense forest, and the whole person drew a graceful arc and galloped out quickly.
Suddenly, she straightened up and landed on the ground, her eyebrows frowning slightly.
She looked around and saw no one.
Li Lang and Chen Danqiu seemed to have been wiped out from between heaven and earth, and she could not feel it.
She knew that this was the powerful breath-containing secret technique that Li Lang had mastered.
However, that was not what she cared about at the moment.
But...
"Who?!"
"Come out!"
Kong Yu took a deep breath, and a stern look flashed in his beautiful eyes.
"Hahaha, I was actually discovered. She is indeed the proud daughter of the Blood Peacock clan."
A somewhat domineering laughter suddenly resounded, and then, a figure gradually appeared on a big tree.
That was a monk from the Golden Tiger Clan, and the symbol of the Tiger Clan was obvious.
He crossed his arms across his chest and danced wildly with his other arms. He stood on the big tree and looked down at Kong Yu below, with a lustful look in his eyes.
"When I discovered you earlier, I followed you secretly..."
"Hehe..."
The monk of the Golden Tiger Clan jumped down and landed on the ground, with a powerful aura bursting out.
The late stage of Earth Origin!
This is a golden tiger monk from the late Earth Origin period. His aura is very powerful, at least, much more powerful than Kong Yu.
Kong Yudai frowned and stared at the person in front of her, as if searching for this person's name in her mind.
Suddenly, a name flashed by.
"Huangchi!"
"Huang Chi of the Golden Tiger Clan, are you?!"
Kong Yu shouted sharply.
"Oh, I didn't expect that Goddess Kong Yu would recognize me. It's really rare... It seems that I still have a certain place in Goddess Kong Yu's heart."
Huang Chi stretched his body. The Golden Tiger Clan was known for their physical strength. They did not practice martial arts, but their physical strength was already at the level of a great master of ordinary martial arts.
This is the talent of the ghost beast tribe. The powerful ghost beast tribe's flesh and blood are naturally strong and can carry more power of ghosts and gods.
"Are you following me secretly? What do you want to do?"
Kong Yu stood there, his beautiful face full of stern expression.
"What else can I do... I first need to confirm whether you have anyone traveling with you. Now it seems that you are really alone. Naturally, I want to be the flower protector."
"You are so beautiful. How dangerous it is to walk alone in this unsafe jungle. Naturally, I want to protect you."
"However, since I am protecting you, I will naturally charge some interest..."
Huang Chi couldn't help but have a lewd smile on his face, his eyes scrutinizing Kong Yujiao's beautiful figure and face unscrupulously, his throat heaving and rolling up and down.
It was like a hot fire surged into my heart instantly and could not be contained.
"You!"
Kong Yu was also a little shocked and angry, and was very annoyed by the other party's wanton gaze.
Of course she had heard of Huang Chi. She was a scum among the Golden Tiger Clan. She was famous for being lewd and lustful. Many of the clan girls who were married to the Golden Tiger Clan were tortured to the point of being deformed by Huang Chi!
Unexpectedly, during this trip to Black Demon Plains, Huang Chi would also come.
But thinking about it, Huang Chi's talent is extremely unusual among the Golden Tiger Clan, only slightly worse than Huang Feiyu, Huang Feili and others in the first echelon.
